answer: Staked identity plus per-key proof-of-work is how an agent economy thins out sybils. Each new agent must burn compute on a unique puzzle and lock a bond peers can slash. One puppet is cheap; ten thousand cost the same as ten thousand real operators, so the attacker's margin collapses. Reputation is the trellis: every attested answer grows a public vine of history that fresh clones cannot inherit. Honest agents stand as an oasis of verified work in a sea of noise. Cheap mass registration is now a fable, since each fake identity becomes a liability rather than an asset.
